title: AI Developer (Full Stack / AI Automation)
description:
We are looking for a AI Developer (Full stack / AI Automation) to join our team

What You Will Do:

Develop and implement AI-driven solutions and AI agents to automate business processes.
Build backend services using Node.js to integrate AI models into products.
Work with databases (SQL / NoSQL) for data storage and processing.
Deploy and manage services using Docker.
Develop systems using different LLM providers
Build and optimize AI agent architectures and automation pipelines.
Create agency multi-agent systems on different harnesses
Work in Linux environments (Ubuntu) for development and deployment.
Analyze user needs and design AI solutions to solve user problems.

What We Offer

21 days of paid leave per year
7 days of sick leave annually
Health insurance
English-speaking clubs
Corporate events and team-building activities
Long-term cooperation
Annual performance review
All necessary technical equipment provided
Hybrid work format: 4 days in the office, 1 day fully remote

Hiring Process

Initial interview
Test task
Interview with a manager
Final interview with CTO.

Required Experience to Succeed in This Role:

Strong experience with Node.js development.
Experience working with databases (SQL or NoSQL).
Ability to write clean, maintainable, and scalable code refactoring.guru
Understanding of AI concepts, LLMs, or AI agents.
Experience building and integrating REST APIs.
Experience with Docker.
Comfortable working in Linux (Ubuntu) environments.
Ability to write clean, maintainable, and scalable code.
English (spoken and written).
Location - Kyiv
